about_the_game:
Welcome at LiFE c.0.d.3!

A semi openworld Third Person - Action Adventure Cyberpunk/Post Apocalyptic style story game.
You can use multiple weapons, attachments, vehicles, close combat skills and bullet time to break through your enemies.



Made by Mario Murkl


Story

One day, as a result of the impact of a piece of meteorite, a virus was released.
The virus that brought humanity to the brink of extinction.



Story by Alexandra Riz

Our hero is Yamato Murkl, a mercenary soldier who is given a mission.
You have to deliver a vaccine from high city to cyber city across the desert.



Music by The Maker

But in the desert you have to fight not only the infected.
Outcasts are also a danger.
Kill them or try to make a deal with them.



The adventure reveals how Yamato became a mercenary soldier, what happened to his family,
who should deliver the vaccine and who caused the virus to be released.



Demo achieved with Unreal Engine 5
The Final game will be updated to Unreal Engine 5.2

I released the full potential of the game engine, i used nanite, and lumen technology for the best results.

Good luck Mercenary!

content_descriptors.notes: Be aware of scary moments, assault, blood, corps, drug/alcohol abuse, and self-harm.
